title: Fixing the rain barrel seal
summary: The seal under the downspout is cracked, and the notes below point to a checklist for replacing it.

# Fixing the rain barrel seal

The rubber seal where the downspout meets the barrel lid has cracked on one
side, and water now runs down the outside of the barrel after every storm.
Before buying parts, work through [the seal checklist](reference/rain-barrel-checklist.md),
which lists the fittings to measure and the order to take them apart in.
A matching seal costs very little, so replacing it is cheaper than moving the
barrel to a spot where the drip would not matter.
